messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — found a deterministic bundler parity bug affecting our JS SDK in edge bundles (vite/rollup). Repro attached.

kai: what breaks exactly?

emma: Repro: when running the sample app built for the edge, the SDK does a retry using a cloned Request but the Authorization header is missing on the retry -> 403. Node/CJS bundles are fine.

emma: Minimal steps:
1) git clone https://example/repro-edge-auth
2) npm ci
3) npm run build:vite-edge (produces dist/esm)
4) npm run serve:edge (local edge shim)
5) curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN123" http://localhost:8787/api/proxy

Observed: first proxied request 200, SDK retry returns 403 because Authorization dropped.

emma: Quick root cause: when bundler resolves the ESM export path, some packagers inline a helper that uses `new Request(req)` instead of `req.clone()`. In our edge shim that ends up not copying header iterables. CJS keeps `req.clone()` and is fine.

nina: any idea which plugin/step causes the helper change?

emma: local bisect points to combination of @rollup/plugin-commonjs + terser tree-shake that removes tiny Request polyfill; bundler falls back to helper that uses new Request(req).

tanner: proposal?

emma: short-term SDK patch: prefer req.clone() and fallback to explicit header copy when clone is not available. Example:
```
function safeClone(req){
  if (typeof req.clone === 'function') return req.clone();
  const headers = new Headers();
  for (const [k,v] of (req.headers || [])) headers.set(k,v);
  return new Request(req.url,{method:req.method,headers,body:req.body});
}
```
Applied that to the repro branch and it passes across vite/rollup/webpack edge builds.

kai: please open an issue and assign eng-runtime. Also add short docs: temporary mitigation to prefer `import * as SDK from 'redwood-sdk'` for edge bundles.

emma: done — issue redwood/sdk#4221 created and branch devex/edge-clone-fallback pushed with CI matrix that builds vite/rollup/webpack and runs edge shim. Link: https://example/repro-edge-auth/compare/devex/edge-clone-fallback

devx-bot: Issue redwood/sdk#4221 created — assigned to @tanner and @eng-runtime. CI queued. :white_check_mark:

tanner: i'll review for streaming/body implications and add unit tests for request cloning across our edge shim matrix. If ok, we'll cut a patch release.

emma: added a short support note: if you see 403 only after retries in edge bundles, try switching import style or upgrade to SDK>=X.Y.Z once released.

kai: great catch — could've been an ugly support escalation. Thanks!
